text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday it bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 40,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat and 20,000 tonnes of Australian wheat, and 30,000 tonnes of Australian barley at its weekly tender.
They are all for October shipment.

BARLEY SALE - Morocco purchased 3,500 tonnes of barley this week instead of 30,000 tonnes planned earlier, an official at the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses (ONICL) said on Thursday.
WHEAT SALES - Philippine firms had bought an additional 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, traders said on Thursday.

Traders involved in the deal said the firms bought 5,500 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $183 to $184 per tonne FOB and 18,500 tonnes dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $178 to $179 per tonne FOB.
The firms also bought a total of 16,000 tonnes western white wheat at $153 to $154 per tonne FOB.
On Tuesday, a Philippine mill also bought 27,000 tonnes U.S. wheat after prices dipped.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it was seeking on August 12, upto 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat for donation to Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for August 24-September 18.

- Morocco, which earlier postponed a tender for up to 130,000 tonnes of soft wheat, re-entered the grain market with a tender to import 90,000 tonnes, European grain traders said. Results of the tender are due on August 12.
- The CCC will tender on August 11 for 27,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Eritrea. The shipment is August 24-September 13.

WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan is tendering on August 12 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat. One shipment of 50,000 tonnes is for October delivery and the rest for November, European traders said.

WHEAT/CORN TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission issued tenders for a combined shipment of 14,000 of spring wheat and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat for September shipment. It was also seeking 18,000 tonnes of corn due for September shipment.

VEGOIL TENDERS - El Salvador was seeking approximately 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,240 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title 1 export program, its U.S. export agent said. Both commodities were slated for October 1-15 shipment. Offers were due on August 14.

- Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be on Sept 8.
MARKET TALK - USDA said it had authorized Pakistan to use $10 million in PL-480 funds to buy U.S. soybean meal. The authorization would pay for about 30,000 tonnes of soybean meal.
... Indonesia is likely to import rice if the El Nino weather pattern prolongs a drought sweeping across the archipelago, industry sources said.
